result.summary: Found 4 issues: content is cut off at the right edge of horizontal scroll sections, a restaurant name is truncated, and there's a redundant/confusing discount label.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card list is cut off at the right edge, showing a partial third card (Trattoria Piccol...) with text and image abruptly clipped by the screen boundary
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding/margin to the scrollable container or ensure a visual cue (like a partial peek with clear edge fade) indicates more content is scrollable

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated and cut off by the screen edge, making it hard to read the full name
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis and adjust card width so the full name or a properly truncated version is visible

issues.description: The pizza promotional banner at the bottom shows a '-0%' discount badge, which is confusing since a 0% discount is not a discount at all
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge if there is no actual discount, or update the logic to only show discount badges when there is a genuine promotional value greater than 0%

issues.description: The pizza promotional image/card at the bottom of the screen is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, making it look abruptly truncated
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content area so cards aren't obscured or cut off by the fixed bottom navigation
